profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm a full-stack developer who utilizes a background in education to collaborate with others, solve problems, multitask and meet clients’ needs using front- and back-end technical skills.  Close attention to detail, resourcefulness, and proven ability to learn quickly are my strengths. I'm known among colleagues for wit, telling it like it is, and my positive outlook no matter the situation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer developing web-based applications for internal and external users. 
- Develop GraphQL APIs and backend services in Elixir using Phoenix and Absinthe
- Utilize Elm and Sass to build user interfaces. 
- Collaborated with designers and product managers throughout the SDLC and led a team of engineers to build new products and features.
- Served as a technical mentor to a new hires
- Lead technical interviews for potential employees.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Developed web-based user interface for students, instructors, and admins for a client in the education space using React, NodeJS, and CSS.
positions.insights: Skills: English · Application Frameworks · Attention to Detail · JSON · Code Review · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) · Single Page Applications

positions.title: Elementary Educator
positions.description:
Mapped out and executed curriculum for 4th and 5th grade classes of up to 33 students. Utilized variety testing methods to measure student performance. Demonstrated effective communication and collaboration between students, parents, team members, and administrators.  Multi-tasked multiple responsibilities daily.

-Chosen out of 19 teachers to mentor student teacher in partnership with Weber State University
-Led and participated in weekly team-wide performance meetings
-Ensured students exceeded achievement standards for Language Arts, Math, and Science
positions.insights: Skills: English · Attention to Detail · Knowledge Sharing

positions.title: Employment Training Specialist
positions.description: Managed a caseload of 25 people with disabilities and oversaw their job search and subsequent successful employment. Provided on-site job training for clients and their respective job coaches. Facilitated constructive and effective communication between clients and employers.

projects.title: HouseWork
projects.description:
From the daily chores to big once-a-year tasks, HouseWork helps you keep track of what needs to be done. We know it's a lot easier tackling these as a team, so we also have the option of assigning jobs to different members within your household.

Visit www.github.com/kfroerer/HouseWork for more details

projects.title: StrataTree
projects.description:
StrataTree allows sales team members to migrate from posterboards and sticky-notes to a web-based app that provides organization and visualization for multiple potential clients.

Visit www.github.com/kfroerer/StrataTree for full details
